LearningNote.title: LearningNote
LearningNote.description: A cybersecurity study note or saved AI brief authored or bookmarked by the authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note owner.

title.description: Short title for the cybersecurity note (1-120 chars).

content.description: Detailed body of the note or AI explanation (1-8000 chars).

pinned.description: Whether the note is pinned for quick reference.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A stored FRIDAY AI Chat or specialized agent conversation entry.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

agentType.description: Originating FRIDAY mode or specialized agent.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was stored (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TerminalLog.title: TerminalLog
TerminalLog.description: An audited, secret-redacted log entry for an approved or rejected terminal/sandbox command.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator.

command.description: Redacted command string submitted by the user (1-1000 chars).

output.description: Redacted stdout/stderr or diagnostic status message (0-8000 chars).

exitCode.description: Process exit code, or -1 if not executed.

approvedByUser.description: Explicit user approval flag required before execution.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log entry was created.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User-scoped cybersecurity learning notes and saved AI briefs.

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: User-scoped FRIDAY AI conversation and agent history.

/users/{userId}/terminal_logs/{logId}.description: User-scoped audited terminal and sandbox execution logs with credentials redacted.
